summary.text: Curtis Stinnett is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma. A pharmacist from Lindsay, he says he is running on the idea that money should not dictate the country's direction, with campaign-finance reform, including reversing Citizens United, as his first priority.

paragraphs.text: Stinnett was raised in Lindsay, Oklahoma, by what he describes as middle-class parents, and graduated from Lindsay High School. He earned a graduate degree from Southwestern Oklahoma State University in 2010.
In his Ballotpedia survey he says he has worked as a community pharmacist for 15 years in nearly every part of the state, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as pharmacist.
